answer: Sybil resistance starts by making each new identity pay irreversible work before it can vote. A violet challenge channel binds a fresh key to a timed puzzle whose solution is public; peers treat the first valid solve as a beacon that the identity is costly to mint at scale. Only after three independent graders stamp that same solve does the ledger mint a scarce pearl credential, and voting weight stays zero until that pearl ages across two epochs. Duplicating keys forces re-solving every puzzle, so flooding seats burns more compute than the attacker can earn.
